name: Cerasinops
sum: Cerasinops is a small ceratopsian from the Campanian Two Medicine Formation of Montana, known from a nearly 80% complete skeleton.
wsnote: Estimate from the nearly complete holotype (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: MOR 300, a skeleton almost 80% complete — Two Medicine Formation, Montana.
material: Holotype plus a specimen collected by Gilmore in 1930s from the same formation.
biology: Herbivore with a beak; no behavioural data.
author: Chinnery and Horner 2007

sources.text: Chinnery, B.J.; Horner, J.R. 2007. A new neoceratopsian dinosaur linking North American and Asian taxa. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 27(3): 625–641. doi:10.1671/0272-4634(2007)27[625:ANNDLN]2.0.CO;2
